name: console-mode-explainer
description: Explainer animation for the Console Mode README

scripts.whats-new: remotion render src/index.ts WhatsNew out/whats-new.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/whats-new.mp4 -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/whats-new.gif
scripts.roadmap: remotion render src/index.ts Roadmap out/roadmap.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/roadmap.mp4 -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/roadmap.gif
scripts.soundtrack: python3 scripts/soundtrack.py && python3 scripts/soundtrack.py launch && python3 scripts/soundtrack.py alpha3 && python3 scripts/soundtrack.py v16 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/soundtrack.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/keynote/soundtrack.mp3 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/launch.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/keynote/launch.mp3 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/alpha3.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/keynote/alpha3.mp3 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/release16.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/keynote/release16.mp3
scripts.launch: remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/launch.mp4 --crf=18 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/launch.mp4 -vf scale=out_range=tv:out_color_matrix=bt709 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/launch-x.mp4
scripts.alpha3: remotion render src/index.ts Alpha3 out/alpha3.mp4 --crf=18 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/alpha3.mp4 -vf scale=out_range=tv:out_color_matrix=bt709 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/alpha3-x.mp4
scripts.release16: remotion render src/index.ts Release16 out/release16.mp4 --crf=18 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/release16.mp4 -vf scale=out_range=tv:out_color_matrix=bt709 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/release16-x.mp4
scripts.features: remotion render src/index.ts Features out/features.mp4 --props="{\"lang\":\"en\"}" && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/features.mp4 -r 15 -vf "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/features.gif
scripts.features:pt: remotion render src/index.ts Features out/features.pt-BR.mp4 --props="{\"lang\":\"pt\"}" && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/features.pt-BR.mp4 -r 15 -vf "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/features.pt-BR.gif
